create_ViTND: create a ViTND model with ndim 5, input shape (4,8,16,32,64), patch size (2,2,4,4,8), dim 512, depth 6, heads 8
build_GoldenGateRoPENd: build a GoldenGateRoPENd rotary embedding with dim_pos 5, heads 8, dim_head 64 for n-dimensional positional encoding
run_ViTND_forward: run a ViTND model forward pass on n-dimensional input tensor and return classification logits
test_Attention: test the Attention module with rotary embeddings applied to query and key tensors
review_Transformer: review the Transformer module with stacked Attention and FeedForward layers using nd rotary embeddings
